tier_reason: Canonical HTTP+realtime client. Every other SDK either wraps this one (react) or ports its wire contract (dotnet/python/flutter/angular).
last_verified_by: workforce and social-inbox wrappers diffed against the Erghi controller source and request models, plus per-SDK wire tests
verification_method: Read javascript/src/resources/*.ts directly against erghi-conversation-api controllers.

auth.evidence: javascript/src/resources/auth.ts:18-93 -- 2026-10-12: auth now targets the real GoTrue routes behind /api/auth/* (/token, /user, /recover, /verify) and maps its snake_case session; earlier refresh/me/password-reset paths did not exist on the platform.

chat.evidence: javascript/src/resources/chat.ts:21-122 -- sendTyping() at :120 invokes 'user.typing' -> SignalR 'SendTyping' via client.ts:265

inbox.note: Workspace surface (member access token), never the visitor surface. Workspace API keys cannot hold view_conversations/manage_inbox_settings/manage_contacts (not grantable), so they get 403. Contacts, notifications, @mentions and unassign require platform PR #256 (not merged when this was written).

workforce.note: Workspace surface. manage_workforce is a grantable API-key permission (status force, sign-out, away reasons, skills, profiles, settings); own status, offers and routing-decision need view_conversations, which a key can never hold, so they need a member token. Reports need view_insights and a plan with workforce analytics. Live board and report bodies are loosely typed (the server builds them ad hoc). PUT profile is not partial. Requires the platform release that adds the Workforce API (not merged when this was written).

social_inbox.note: Workspace surface. moderate_social is a grantable API-key permission (hide, reply, private reply, done, ignore); connections and settings need configure_ai, the report needs view_insights. The social inbox ships dark (403 social_inbox_unavailable). The Meta OAuth connect flow is deliberately not wrapped (browser-only). Requires the platform release that adds the social inbox (not merged when this was written).

rag.note: No RAG resource client anywhere in this SDK. Platform has one (Erghi/Erghi.Conversation/Api/Controllers/RagController.cs) that no SDK wraps yet -- this is a platform-wide gap, not JS-specific drift.

webhooks.note: No customer-facing outbound webhook registration API exists on the platform yet (only inbound provider webhooks like Telegram). Nothing to wrap.

reply_engine.evidence: javascript/src/resources/replyEngines.ts, javascript/src/agentRuntime.ts, javascript/src/webhooks.ts; tests: replyEngines.test.ts, agentRuntime.test.ts, webhooks.test.ts
reply_engine.note: Unreleased; written against the platform reply-engine worktree (API version 2026-11-22), not yet verified against a deployed platform. Live hub client reconnects and calls Resume(lastSequence).

notes: Reference implementation. Any capability added here and not propagated to dotnet/python/flutter/angular/widget within a release cycle is a real parity gap -- react inherits automatically since it wraps this package's client object directly.
